reddit.title: Improving Colony Music: Soft Music Reloops
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to our colony music system in Provincia! No more jarring transitions as day, night, title, and combat beds now seamlessly crossfade into each other. This enhancement ensures a smoother audio experience while you build your colony. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Audio Enhancements in Provincia: Soft Music Reloops
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce that the audio experience in Provincia has been significantly improved! The music beds for day, night, title, and combat now feature smooth crossfades, eliminating any awkward audio cuts. This enhancement aims to provide a more immersive gameplay experience. For full details, visit our devtalk here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
